messages.author: 33d5534e21fbbe0f
messages.subject: unable to install_github()
parts:
Hi, On an R 2.12.2, devtools v0.2 Windows installation, I first try:

> install_github("roxygen", "klutometis")

and receive the following error message:

Loading required package: RCurl
Loading required package: bitops
Installing roxygen from klutometis
Error in unzip(src, list = TRUE) : zip file '.' cannot be opened


I next tried installing locally from the tar.gz file and receive the
following error message:

Error in gzfile(file, "r") : cannot open the connection
In addition: Warning message:
In gzfile(file, "r") :
cannot open compressed file 'hadley-devtools-devtools-0.3-41-
gb32f459/DESCRIPTION', probable reason 'No such file or directory'

I next try updating devtools from github with

> install_github("devtools")

and receive a similar error message:

Installing devtools from hadley
Error in unzip(src, list = TRUE) : zip file '.' cannot be opened


I would appreciate any advice and insights. Thanks for your time.

parts:
Hadley,

While I can't install through "install_github()" or manually after downloading anything from "klutometis", i've been able to download and install roxygen2 using,

> install.packages("roxygen2_2.0.tar.gz",type="source",repos=NULL)

When I first ran 'roxygenize', I realized that - unlike roxygen::roxygenize - it expects an existing NAMESPACE file.  After correcting that and running again, I receive the following error and warning messages:


Updating namespace directives
Error in roclet_rd_one(partitum, base_path) : Missing name
In addition: Warning messages:
1: nord is an unknown key
2: nord is an unknown key
3: Empty export directive
4: Empty export directive
5: Empty export directive
6: Empty export directive
7: Empty export directive
8: Empty export directive


I'd appreciate any insight you would offer.  using the old 'roxygen' package with use.Rd2 = FALSE will write the documents, but ignoring @rdname tags and writing other redundant documentation. 



Error in roclet_rd_one(partitum, base_path) : Missing name

On Wed, Jul 27, 2011 at 5:58 PM, terrance savitsky <tds...@gmail.com> wrote:
By way of background, in the process of creating a package I first found your "advanced R development" pages and they quite helped demystify the process.  I then found devtools and used the roxygen package with (Rd2=TRUE option) to build the 3 roclet types.  As an aside, I used roxygenize instead of "document" because I liked the option to write to another file while in development.  As I moved onto testthat and read your R journal article, the process you described of recognizing the need/benefit to make one's code more modular to promote better test writing overcame me and I re-structured quite a bit.  When I returned to roxygen, I couldn't get it to work with option Rd2=TRUE, but could without it.  (When Rd2=TRUE, messages are provided indicating the documentation has been created, but then I receive the following error message, " Error in final[[1]] : subscript out of bounds").  As I want to use some of the Rd2 features, I decided better to move on to roxygen2.  

While a Windows binary file is unavailable for roxygen2 on CRAN, i was able to install.package it from source.  When I run roxygenize under the roxygen2 package, it finds my package file and seems to create and check the .Rd files because it returns some warnings (about not recognizing @nord tags), but then puts out the following error:
Error in file(con, "r") : cannot open the connection

In addition: There were 12 warnings (use warnings() to see them)

So it finds my package file and does everything except complete the output step. I think it's the use of 'roxygen2' that produces the same error message under "document" from devtools_0.4.  The only relevant discussions I find on this error related to packages suggest the package tar file I'm using is not built for the platform on which I'm using it, Windows.

Lastly, returning to your previous email, I reinstalled both devtools_0.4  and tried the following:
> install_github("roxygen", "klutometis")

Installing roxygen from klutometis
Error in unzip(src, list = TRUE) :

zip file 'C:\DOCUME~1\savitsky\LOCALS~1\Temp\RtmpKNYsQU/klutometis-roxygen.zip' cannot be opened


I don't know if the problem is local to my machine or a broader issue.  Maybe I need to try the whole process on another windows machine.

T.

install_github("roxygen", "klutometis")
